purpose: Versioned corrected rerun: preserve v1/v2 raw observations while fixing causal anytime timing, explicit manifest selection, overwrite protection, and compact lossless advisor evidence.
scientific_model: unchanged from protocol-v1 and protocol-v2; this version changes only evidence accounting and reproduction safeguards

timing_corrections.clock_start: before preprocessing and first objective evaluation
timing_corrections.incumbent_history: record actual completion elapsed seconds for initial and every accepted independently evaluated incumbent
timing_corrections.checkpoint_rule: checkpoint c may use only the last incumbent with completion_elapsed_seconds <= c; otherwise available=false
timing_corrections.deadline: do not accept an evaluation completing after the wall cap; record overshoot and retain the previous valid incumbent
timing_corrections.slow_regression: a test-only deterministic objective delay crosses 0.05 and 0.1 seconds; it is not benchmark evidence

evidence_policy.output: new output paths only; write_json_once refuses an existing path, including preserved v1/v2 names
evidence_policy.scratch: reruns must use a new explicitly named scratch output path; historical evidence is never overwritten
evidence_policy.advisor_representation: compact lossless summary of statuses, selections, objective checks, bounds, tolerances and timings; no repeated solver value arrays
evidence_policy.raw_lineage: v1/v2 raw JSON remains archival and timing-unfit for future time-to-target claims

unchanged: methods, seeds 3501/3502/3503, 10-second cap, checkpoints 0.05/0.1/0.25/0.5/1/2/5/10, exact Fraction objective and NO-GO decision rule remain unchanged
